title: Console UI: Audit Export settings page (destinations, filters, status, test connection) for SIEM export beta
creator: Dylan Brooks
project: Enterprise Security & Compliance Foundation: SIEM-ready audit export (Beta)
description:
Build the Redwood Console UI surface for the SIEM-ready audit export beta.

Scope:
- Settings page under Admin/Security for managing Audit Export configurations (create/update/disable/delete) behind feature flag + tenant allowlist.
- Destination setup forms for Splunk HEC, Datadog Logs, and S3 delivery.
- Filter builder (category/action allowlist/denylist) and backfill controls (start/backfill window) per product spec.
- Status/health view: export lag, last delivered timestamp, last error, adapter health, and per-destination state.
- "Test connection" flow for destinations (where supported) + UX for success/failure + safe redaction of secrets.
- Empty/error states and guidance copy for beta limitations.

Non-scope:
- Private/on-prem UX (explicitly call out in copy)
- Advanced troubleshooting UI (link to runbook + support)

Primary stakeholders:
- PM: Naomi Feldman (beta scope)
- Security: Marcus Lin / Kevin Osei (PII + permissions)
- Console: Dylan Brooks (lead), Chloe Martin (backend)
- Design: Tessa Morgan / Alicia Perez

References:
- Confluence spec: audit-export-configuration-and-filtering-spec
- Schema mapping: audit-event-schema-v2-and-siem-mapping
- SLO/alerting: audit-exporter-slos-and-alerting
- Control plane APIs: ENG-5132 + status endpoint PR-28805

Acceptance criteria:
1) Admins with correct RBAC can view the Audit Export page and current configuration(s).
2) Create/edit flows validate required fields and show clear inline errors.
3) Secrets are never displayed after save; rotation UX uses "replace" interaction.
4) Status module renders:
   - Current state (Enabled / Paused / Error)
   - Export lag + last success
   - Last error summary with "copy error" action
5) Empty states:
   - Feature disabled state (beta not enabled) with request process
   - No exports configured state with CTA
6) Error states:
   - Permissions denied
   - Backend unavailable
   - Destination test failure
7) All surfaces gated behind feature flag + tenant allowlist; no leakage in nav for non-enabled tenants.

Implementation notes (UI):
- Route: /console/admin/security/audit-export (exact path may adjust to Console nav conventions)
- Component split: SettingsShell, DestinationsTable, DestinationFormModal, FiltersPanel, BackfillPanel, StatusPanel, TestConnectionDialog
- Copy: include beta disclaimer (at-least-once delivery, customer dedup expected; retention/backfill limits), and link to FAQ.

Implementation notes (API integration):
- Read/write export configs via control plane CRUD endpoint (ENG-5132)
- Read status via exporter status endpoint (PR-28805)
- Test connection endpoint (if present) should be POST with server-side validation; if not available in control plane yet, UI should hide/disable and show "Contact support" for beta.

A11y:
- Keyboard accessible modal flow
- Form field errors via aria-describedby
- Status badges with text labels (not color-only)

Analytics/telemetry:
- Track page views + create/update/disable actions
- Track test connection attempts + outcomes (no secrets in event payload)

QA:
- Unit test form validation
- Mock API integration tests for empty/permission/error states
- Manual checklist for Splunk/Datadog/S3 sample configs (use non-prod tokens)

Rollout:
- Feature flag: SIEM_AUDIT_EXPORT_BETA (tenant allowlisted)
- Hide nav entry unless enabled

Risk callouts:
- Avoid any rendering of sensitive fields (HEC token, Datadog API key, AWS role external ID); ensure backend never returns secrets to UI.
- Ensure error toasts/logging do not include secrets (sanitize).
